_about: Non-chest OoTR locations the seed generator randomizes, by OoTR name. Each must be matched one-to-one to a remake location in data/ootr_match.json; the patcher changes every give step of that location (the item name in the giver's scene, or, for a progressive item, 'give the right tier' steps; data/rando/scene_give_modes.json says where that's possible). 'testing': in play, not yet seen working in-game; 'verified': seen working. NPC rewards that need more than their give step changed are patched by parity plugins instead and are not listed here: songs_trade (LLR Talons Chickens: only the first win's hand-over, Event23, gets the item, the later milk refills stay; the two-step NPCs; both frog heart pieces (one location id held both); Kak Man on Roof; GC Rolling Goron as Child; Graveyard Dampe Gravedigging Tour; cows, frogs, loach; GC Medigoron and Kak Granny Buy Blue Potion with shuffle_expensive_merchants), shops (Wasteland Bombchu Salesman, scrubs).
